effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.
qualifications: For every fixed C ≥ 0 and every finite nonnegative function h, assume there is a computable threshold function T with h(k) ≤ k/j for every positive integer j and every k ≥ T(j).
The function h itself need not be computable.

reader.title: All-ones right-hand-side integer programming under FPT ≠ W[1]

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides feasibility of Ax=b for the stated all-ones right-hand side within the stated running time.
